name: Y2K kawaii
notes: Y2K maximalist magazine-cover energy: one huge chunky display number or word across the top, a glossy 3D candy-plastic mascot floating centre on a flat electric field, small corner badges, a vertical katakana-style side column and a barcode strip. Japanese pop influence, saturated and playful.

name: Zine riot
notes: DIY punk gig zine: a grainy high-contrast black-and-white photo centre, flanked by bold flat neon chevron arrows, sparkle stars in the corners, and a chunky hand-drawn wobbly outlined headline stacked at the bottom. Three colours only: near-black, white, one hot accent. Screen-print grain, collage feel.

name: Minimalist
notes: Swiss modernist editorial poster: cream textured ground, a single duotone photo subject dominating the middle, a ghosted oversized year in the background, a small circular badge top-left, a tiny italic quote top-right, and one massive ultra-bold condensed sans-serif word with a full stop anchoring the bottom third.

name: Swiss mask
notes: Type-as-window poster: one flat vivid background colour, a single ultra-bold condensed word spanning the full width, with a photograph showing only through the letterforms. Tiny definition text bottom-left. Bold, minimal, conceptual.

name: Retro travel
notes: 1970s tourism-board poster: white ground, a fine small label on top, a large bold condensed destination name, then a solid coloured rectangular panel framing a single illustrated hero subject like a postcard window, and a fine board-of-tourism line at the bottom. Four colours, vintage charm.

name: Psychedelic type
notes: Liquid-type festival poster: one saturated background colour, the headline word repeated three times stacked vertically in a contrasting colour with wavy, melting, warped letterforms filling the centre. A small header line top, venue and dates small bottom-left, tiny logos bottom-right.

name: Pop art brutalism
notes: Typographic wallpaper theatre poster: the headline repeated seven times in massive black condensed rows filling the sheet, with a hot-pink halftone portrait inside a spiky starburst overlaid dead centre. Cream ground, fine credit lines at the bottom. Strictly two colours plus cream.

name: 90s athletic
notes: Sports-ad poster: a saturated flat background, the slogan repeated four times in huge bold condensed rows full-width, with grainy halftone black-and-white action figures cut out and layered over the type. Small brand mark bottom-left. Momentum through typographic repetition.

name: Airbrush surrealism
notes: Handmade spray-art zine: cream ground, a big irregular organic spray-paint blob in one electric colour with soft halo edges, filled with a grid of repeated cartoon line-art motifs, bold condensed title on top, a wavy line, and three small labelled columns along the bottom.

name: Modern constructivism
notes: Bauhaus-constructivist product poster: cream ground with large overlapping geometric shapes (a big circle, a rectangle, a semicircle) in red and black, one large character or letter top-right, a vertical text column left, and a crisp black-and-white product photo placed on top of the shapes. Three colours, sharp and graphic.

name: Mid-century editorial
notes: Minimal magazine cover: clean white ground, a bold display masthead across the top with one playful nested letterform, a small issue line top-right, a single vivid object photographed and isolated dead centre, a small emblem bottom-right. Generous white space, one accent colour only.

name: Maximalist flyer
notes: Chaotic academic event flyer: one hot flat background, the headline broken mid-syllable into four enormous stacked lines that fill the sheet, irregular black starburst shapes scattered over it, tiny labels in the corners, a vertical side line, schedule small type at the bottom, one word in white inside a burst.

name: Kinetic illusion
notes: Optical-illusion broadcast poster: a saturated flat ground covered edge to edge with a fine white perspective-warped grid, a large 3D sphere wrapped with bold type sitting on the net, venue and date small in the top corners, a stacked bold headline lower-left, sponsor marks bottom. Strictly two colours.

name: Japanese grid
notes: Product-packaging repeat: a tight seamless grid of the same illustrated can or object tiled full-bleed, each carrying a bold condensed wordmark, a vertical script column and fine spec text. Strictly two tones (deep navy and cream), textile-like, Showa-era industrial feel.

name: Industrial techno
notes: Brutalist tech-event poster: electric flat ground, a massive ultra-bold white condensed headline stacked in two lines dominating the top, a black-and-white photo of a retro object tangled with chrome pipe forms in the middle, bold date stacked bottom-right, small institution mark and address bottom-left.

name: Holographic interface
notes: Neo-brutalist tech branding sheet: cream upper zone with a giant black condensed logotype, an orange pill label strip, tiny spec labels, crosshair and barcode marks; a big black panel below holding a single iridescent chrome 3D star; a boxed line diagram and small body copy bottom. Strict grid, one accent colour.

name: Halftone indie
notes: Indie gig poster: a vivid flat background, a 3x3 grid of circular duotone risograph portraits filling the top two-thirds, a big bold italic condensed name below, then venue, date and access note as three small columns at the bottom, a tiny logo centred. Three colours.

name: Grindhouse
notes: Movie-character poster: warm flat ground, big brush-style display characters top-left, a small inked portrait panel top-right, a short bullet list mid-left, a single glossy 3D object hanging from the top edge dead centre with a hard cast shadow, bold condensed name over a black splat bottom-left, fine date beneath. Three colours.

name: Fluid metallic
notes: Gallery-opening poster: pure white ground scattered with photoreal liquid-chrome blobs of varying sizes, with large cropped ultra-bold condensed black text bleeding off the edges so words read as fragments, year and date as display type mid-sheet, venue fragments bottom. Strictly black, white and chrome.

name: Eurodance
notes: Y2K anarchist split poster: upper two-thirds a vivid flat acid colour, lower third a black panel with a clean divide; a large chrome 3D four-point star centre with a flat dark human silhouette in profile over it; a vertical column of fragmented bold letters down the left edge; barcode strip and a big © year bottom-right.

name: Keycap pop
notes: Object-collage poster: white cream ground, oversized 3D rendered objects (keyboard keycaps) scattered at angles filling the frame, each carrying one letter that together spell the headline. Primary colours red, blue, green, yellow, grey. Small series label top-left, headline top-right, a vertical descriptor down the right edge, small caption bottom.

name: DIY punk
notes: Punk gig poster: near-black ground, one large flat neon illustration (skeletons) in a dynamic contorted pose with no outlines or shading, bold condensed white band name and event lines stacked top-left, a tiny venue logo bottom-right. Three colours: black, white, one hot neon.

name: CMYK overprint
notes: Risograph pop-art poster: saturated flat yellow ground, a massive bold serif uppercase word across the top, small caps captions in three columns beneath, and a portrait photo repeated three or four times in offset cyan, magenta and black silhouettes receding into the background. Deliberate misregistration, raw zine energy.

name: Classic Bauhaus
notes: Bauhaus centenary exhibition poster: soft blush ground, a small institution label top-left and a logo block top-right, a massive ultra-bold black lowercase display word broken across three lines with one disruptive oversized capital, a vivid lime duotone photo of dancing figures overlaid centre, italic serif exhibition details bottom-left.

name: Acid graphic
notes: Rave poster: soft lavender ground with a blurred glowing aura figure in warm coral-orange floating centre, a fine presenter line and small lineup names at the top, two columns of large bold condensed black names at the bottom with a small italic word between them, then date, venue and hours as a fine bottom row.
